## Block

What does this Block do? Link to its public source and the pinned revision.

## Contribution checks

- [ ] I am the publisher or have permission to submit this Block.
- [ ] My listing filename, ID, and slug follow the schema.
- [ ] The source repository and pinned commit are accessible and contain the declared license.
- [ ] My description explains setup, limitations, and requested capabilities.
- [ ] The listing contains no credentials, private URLs, or private source.
- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run validate` pass.

Catalog checks validate metadata only. OS installation is not available yet.
